bullets.text: 6G's AI-Driven Future - **Qualcomm** outlines three pillars for 6G: connectivity, computing, and sensing, essential for AI services.
Telcos Falling Short - A **Capgemini** report reveals 74% of enterprises expect outcomes from telcos, but only 39% see results.
AI Needs Context - **Totogi** emphasizes that without proper context, AI in telecoms leads to unreliable outcomes.
Military 5G Insights - **Telefónica**'s military 5G deployments provide a model for resilient private networks in enterprises.
Huawei's AI-Centric Solutions - At MWC 2026, **Huawei** launches AI-centric network solutions to enhance 5G-A and transition to 6G.
AI and 5G-A Convergence - **Huawei** discusses integrating AI into 5G-A networks to enhance service and network intelligence.
Trust in AI Era - **Orange** CEO stresses the need for telcos to build trust as AI becomes integral to digital society.
Cloud RAN Efficiency - A trial shows how **AT&T** and **Ericsson** leverage AI in Cloud RAN to enhance network efficiency.
AI Agents on the Rise - **Qualcomm** predicts 2026 will be the year of AI agents, transforming mobile interactions.
